title: Breath Counting
description: Count each out-breath from one to ten, then begin again. Opens and closes with chapters 16 and 15.

steps.text: Find a comfortable position, seated or lying down. Let your hands rest wherever they feel natural.
When you're ready, let your eyes close, or soften your gaze toward the floor in front of you.
Before we begin, a few lines from the Tao Te Ching.
Take a slow breath in through the nose. And let it go.
Once more. Breathe in. And out, a little slower than usual.
Now let the breath find its own rhythm. You don't need to control it. Just notice it.
We'll count the breaths. Each time you breathe out, count silently. One. Then two. Up to ten. Then begin again at one.
For the first round, I'll count with you.
If you lose the count, that's fine. Noticing that you lost it is the practice. Just begin again at one.
Now let go of the counting. Let the breath be just as it is.
Begin to notice the room around you. The sounds. The weight of your body.
When you're ready, open your eyes.
